title: Insure residential building work (home warranty)
what: Take out home warranty (home building compensation) insurance for residential building work before starting, and give the owner the certificate.

sources.title: Home Building Act 1989 (NSW)
sources.publisher: Official register text via the Open Australian Legal Corpus
sources.quote: A person must not do residential building work under a contract unless— (a) a contract of insurance that complies with this Act is in force in relation to that work
